presentation.label: Cough
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us about your cough and when it started.

questions.question: Are you bringing up phlegm or mucus when you cough?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient is producing phlegm or mucus when coughing?

questions.question: Have you coughed up any blood?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has coughed up blood?

questions.question: Have you had any chest pain?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has chest pain?

questions.question: Have you had a fever?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has had a fever?

questions.question: Are you feeling short of breath?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient is feeling short of breath?

questions.question: Have you taken any antibiotics recently?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has taken antibiotics recently?

questions.question: Have you had any recent investigations for this problem, such as blood tests, X-rays or scans?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has had recent investigations such as blood tests, X-rays or scans?

shortness_of_breath_safety.message: This form is for routine issues and it may take several days to receive a response. If you are feeling short of breath, phone the duty doctor instead of submitting this form.
